author: The Critical Drinker
description:
Supergirl isn't just bombing, its causing a full scale Hollywood meltdown. Meanwhile, Nolan's Odyssey released its final trailer, and promptly got ratioed into oblivion, and Taylor Sheridan blasted Hollywood critics who hate him. Join me, MauLer, Nerdrotic, Little Platoon, Film Comics Explained and Colhauser for Open Bar 191.
